rootCause: JdbcBatchExecutionControlPlaneAdapter is final while its bean is advised by the active class-based Spring AOP policy, so CGLIB cannot construct the production bean.
requiredFix: Audit all actual Batch advised bean types, remove only incompatible final modifiers at the exact owners, add a class-based proxy regression, rebuild, and replay the Fresh runtime.

sourceFix.auditResult: JdbcBatchExecutionControlPlaneAdapter was the only final Batch main type declaring @Transactional methods.
sourceFix.ownerFix: Removed only the final modifier; transaction annotations and class-based AOP policy are unchanged.
